About Us

Woodsmith Construction is a Bucks County-based construction company specializing in outdoor living projects and select residential construction. Our work includes custom decks, pavilions and roof covers, porches and porticos, patios and hardscaping, additions, and custom framing.

The company is led by owner and builder Pete Buechle and is licensed in Pennsylvania and New Jersey. We focus on projects where planning, structural knowledge, craftsmanship, and clear communication all matter..

Why Homeowners Choose Woodsmith

Our projects often combine multiple trades, structural details, and finish materials. We bring those pieces together under one plan, with an experienced field team and a clear point of responsibility from start to finish..

  • Outdoor Living Specialization — A focused portfolio of decks, roof covers, porches, patios, hardscaping, and related residential construction.

  • Design-to-Build Coordination — Planning, drawings, material selections, permitting coordination, and construction managed as one process.

  • Experienced Field Construction — Practical building knowledge with attention to structure, water management, finish details, and long-term durability.

  • Clear Project Communication — Straightforward expectations, defined scopes, and communication throughout the project.
